evidence: mobile-native/androidApp/src/main/java/three/two/bit/ppt/reality/navigation/Navigation.kt:493 — the Screen.CreateListing composable wires `onSubmit = { _ -> Result.failure(NotImplementedError("Wire to listing API")) }`, so every realtor submit of the Create Listing form fails unconditionally. The screen is fully built and reachable in production: MyListingsScreen.onCreateClick (Navigation.kt:484) navigates to Screen.CreateListing, and CreateListingScreen (ui/realtor/CreateListingScreen.kt:41,95,109,121) collects a complete CreateListingInput, has a submit footer, and calls onCreated()/popBackStack on success — but PortalListingsRepository (shared/.../realtor/PortalListingsRepository.kt) exposes only listMyListings / getListingAnalytics / getPortfolioAnalytics and NO create method, so the feature is unwired end-to-end. A realtor can fill out the entire form and always sees a failure. Fix: add a create-listing call to PortalListingsRepository (POST reality-server listing endpoint) and wire the real suspend handler into Navigation.kt, or gate the CreateListing route/button behind a feature flag until the API is wired.

shared/src/commonMain/.../listing/ListingRepository.kt:39-41 (and :59,74,93,112,139) — suspend network methods use `catch (e: Exception) { Result.failure(e) }`. In Kotlin coroutines CancellationException IS an Exception, so this swallows coroutine cancellation: a cancelled call is converted into Result.failure instead of propagating, breaking structured concurrency (the parent scope's cancellation does not take effect and downstream UI treats cancellation as a real error). The same unguarded `catch (e: Exception)` pattern repeats across 7 repositories that do NOT rethrow CancellationException — AgencyRepository, FavoritesRepository, InquiryRepository, ListingRepository, NotificationRepository, PortalListingsRepository, RealtorRepository (and SsoService.kt:52,81,107,132,180,207,235,261,302). The author already knows the correct pattern: LayoutRepository.getListingDetailLayout (shared/.../layout/LayoutRepository.kt:65-66) explicitly does `catch (e: CancellationException) { throw e }` before the generic catch and documents it. Fix: add a `catch (e: CancellationException) { throw e }` arm ahead of the generic catch in every suspend fun of these repositories (or route them through a shared safeApiCall helper that rethrows cancellation).

shared/src/commonMain/.../auth/SsoService.kt (348 lines) has NO direct unit test: no file under shared/src/commonTest references SsoService, loginWithPassword, validateAndLogin, refreshSession, or AuthLogin. It owns the session-critical auth HTTP surface — createMobileToken, validateAndLogin (SSO token redemption), getSession, refreshSession, loginWithPassword, register, requestPasswordReset, confirmPasswordReset, updateProfile, restoreSession — yet every other repository in the module has at least a mock-engine or path-encoding test (FavoritesRepositoryTest, InquiryRepositoryPathEncodingTest, NotificationRepositoryTest, PortalListingsRepositoryTest, ListingDetailRepositoryTest, LayoutRepositoryTest, etc.). Note the SSO CSRF/nonce contract (SsoStateStore/SsoInitiation) IS tested; the gap is the service that performs the actual auth network calls and status-code branching. Add a commonTest SsoServiceTest using Ktor MockEngine to cover success/non-2xx/decode-failure branches of validateAndLogin, loginWithPassword, refreshSession, and the password-reset pair.
